decisions.reason: Uses ls-remote tag list and branch-only sync script to prove v0.9.5 never reached the mirror, ties to attempt-1 ref-resolution failure, explicitly rules out network/typo/npm causes.

Explains v0.9.7 targets 0.1.2-alpha.1 while consumer runs 0.1.1-rc.2, so the useConversation seat is absent; install success and restart prove nothing about API compatibility; direction clearly one-way.

Selects v0.9.3 via rc.1 verification plus additive rc.2 note, notices v0.9.3 also missing from mirror, gives #v0.9.3 install after maintainer tag push, SHA alternative kept conditional and uninvented; no DSH upgrade required.
Proposes explicit per-mirror git push of refs/tags/<tag> grounded in the branch-only script, plus per-mirror ls-remote verification that fails the release.
README becomes a per-DSH-version matrix (0.1.1-rc.x -> v0.9.3; 0.1.2-alpha.1 -> v0.9.7) with routing rule by runtime version; no single newest-tag default, no support claim for untested alphas.
